positions.claim: An engineer's impact from enabling non-engineer teammates can exceed the impact of doing more engineering themselves.
Engineers' roles will need to shift from builders to enablers and teachers as more non-engineers work in code.
The primary enabler of her shift to design engineer was owning the entire process and having agency, more than the AI tooling itself.
AI-driven velocity looks fundamentally different in 1-3 person zero-to-one teams than in organizations of thousands with 5-20 year old software.
Designers should build the working prototype first and return to Figma only later for visual fine-tuning, inverting the traditional high-fidelity-mockup-first workflow.
Recording exploration chats and ideas into a Claude Code project folder file system significantly speeds up both collaboration and subsequent building.
Adopting AI tools in a large organization is a human behavior change problem, so tool access alone is insufficient without champions, experimentation space, and agency.
Removing risk from a project (building something unrelated to existing products) is what allowed the team to focus on learning.
Well-documented asynchronous work practices are a prerequisite for making internal knowledge usefully accessible to AI tools.
A non-engineer can ship to production in a large legacy system when systems and operations teams have invested in security, process, and documentation quality.
